newsitem.title: USA: Texas mother found guilty of murdering sons.
newsitem.headline: Texas mother found guilty of murdering sons.

text.p: A Texas jury Saturday found Darlie Routier guilty of murdering her two young sons while they slept in their Rowlett, Texas home near Dallas.

Routier, 27, silently wept and shivered when the verdict was read by state District Judge Mark Tolle. Husband Darin Routier, sitting nearby in the courtroom, also put his face into his hands and cried.
An angry Routier family member shouted at prosecutor Greg Davis: "You'll burn in hell for this."
The jury of seven women and five men was to return Monday to consider Routier's punishment. Davis told reporters he would ask that she be sentenced to death by lethal injection.
"Anyone willing to take the life of two innocent children is willing to do anything," he said.
The verdict, which came after nearly 10 hours of deliberation over two days, climaxed a trial that began on Jan. 6 in this small town 60 miles (96 km) northwest of San Antonio, Texas.

Prosecutors charged that on the night of June 6 Routier stabbed sons Devon, 6, and Damon, 5, to death with a butcher knife because she was upset about the family's financial problems and dissatisfied with her appearance after gaining weight during her pregnancy with a third son, Drake.
But she testified that an intruder killed the boys and attacked her before fleeing the house. Davis said Routier's testimony, which highlighted many inconsistencies in her story, may have hurt.
"I do think the defendant's testimony was one of the best weapons (for the prosecution) in this case," he said.

Defence attorney Richard Mosty said the verdict would be appealed. He hugged the weeping Routier and spoke briefly with her before she was led away by bailiffs. "She said 'I did not kill my babies,'" he told reporters.
The trial was moved to Kerrville because of heavy pre-trial publicity in the Dallas area
